title.en: Does the Electric 10 Series fit a 25 m rural line?
title.zh: 电动10系列对得上 25 米的农村管路吗？

description.en: Yes, inside the printed horizontal cell: 15 kW, 21 m³/h, 23 MPa, 25 m horizontal, aggregate 2 cm and below, 400 kg. No vertical cell is printed.
description.zh: 可以，停在已印的水平格内：15 kW、21 m³/h、23 MPa、水平 25 m、骨料 2 cm 及以下、400 kg。没有印垂直格。

h1.en: Does the Electric 10 Series fit a 25 m rural line?
h1.zh: 电动10系列对得上 25 米的农村管路吗？

directAnswer.en: Yes, when the horizontal run stays inside 25 m and the stone is 2 cm and below. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints rural self-built houses, small sites and secondary structure on the Electric 10 Series: 15 kW, 21 m³/h, 23 MPa, hopper 0.1 m³, horizontal 25 m, 1800 × 800 × 1200 mm and 400 kg. The table does not print a vertical distance. This page will not invent one.
directAnswer.zh: 可以，只要水平不超过 25 m，石子在 2 cm 及以下。邢台河北品锦机械在电动10系列上印了农村自建房、小型工地和二次结构：15 kW、21 m³/h、23 MPa、料斗 0.1 m³、水平 25 m、外形 1800 × 800 × 1200 mm、400 kg。表上没有垂直距离。本页不编一个。

heading.en: 15 kW does not copy Electric 15’s metres
heading.zh: 15 kW 不会抄来电动15的米数

body.en: Electric 15 is also 15 kW, but it prints 8–10 m³/h, 15–20 m vertical, 60–80 m horizontal, 1–3 cm aggregate and 450 kg. The two-to-three-floor sentence on the Electric 15 note stays on Electric 15. A rural line longer than 25 m horizontal leaves the Electric 10 Series even if the motor size looks the same.
body.zh: 电动15也是 15 kW，但它印的是 8–10 m³/h、垂直 15–20 m、水平 60–80 m、骨料 1–3 cm、450 kg。电动15说明里的两三层那句话留在电动15上。农村管路水平长于 25 m 时，即使电机看起来一样，也要离开电动10系列。

heading.en: 21 m³/h is not the Electric 40 building row
heading.zh: 21 m³/h 不是电动40的建筑行

body.en: Electric 40 also prints 21 m³/h, at 45 kW, with fine stone 120 m / 360 m and a 2300 kg frame. Same output figure, different application sentence and different distance. The Electric 10 Series hopper is 0.1 m³. Electric 40’s hopper is 0.4 m³.
body.zh: 电动40也印了 21 m³/h，但是 45 kW，细石 120 m / 360 m，机架 2300 kg。输送量数字相同，应用句和距离不同。电动10系列料斗是 0.1 m³。电动40料斗是 0.4 m³。

heading.en: What should Xingtai receive with the inquiry?
heading.zh: 向邢台询盘要带上什么？

body.en: Send horizontal metres only if you measured them, and say the vertical cell is absent from this table. Send Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai the mix, the largest stone or particle, the output you need, the horizontal and vertical pipe you measured, and whether the site has grid voltage or must use diesel. Use /contact, the on-site WhatsApp button, PinjinHebei@Outlook.com or 19912003025. Do not attach a project name, a country job or a daily volume the catalogue does not print.
body.zh: 只有量过才发水平米数，并说明这张表没有垂直格。 请把配合比、最大石子或粒径、需要的输送量、量到的水平与垂直管路，以及现场是电网还是必须用柴油，发给邢台的河北品锦机械。途径是 /contact、站内 WhatsApp、PinjinHebei@Outlook.com 或 19912003025。不要附上目录里没有的项目名称、国家工程或日浇筑方量。

answer.en: Yes. 23 MPa. That is unlike Electric 15, which does not print a pressure cell.
answer.zh: 印了。23 MPa。这和电动15不同，电动15没有压力格。

question.en: Is 2 cm the same as Electric 15’s 1–3 cm?
question.zh: 2 cm 和电动15的 1–3 cm 一样吗？

answer.en: No. Electric 10 Series prints 2 cm and below.
answer.zh: 不一样。电动10系列印的是 2 cm 及以下。

question.en: Does the page include a vertical “about 25 m”?
question.zh: 页面有垂直“大约 25 m”吗？

answer.en: No. Only horizontal 25 m is printed.
